# Pure Writer

> Pure Writer (纯纯写作 in Simplified Chinese, 純純寫作 in Traditional Chinese, 純純執筆 in Japanese) is a fast plain text editor you can trust, with History, cloud sync and backups, layers of protection against losing your work, and many thoughtful writing aids. It is available for Android, iPhone and iPad, with a desktop version for Windows and macOS.

Pure Writer is a text editor for writing and organizing your own text. It does not offer books, magazines or other reading content, and it has no community, feed or publishing platform. What you write is never made public or shown to anyone else. Documents are stored on your device, backups and sync go only to your own iCloud or cloud drive, and Pure Writer's servers do not store your writing.

Pure Writer for iOS requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later. Every feature can be tried free for 7 days; afterwards a monthly subscription, a yearly subscription or a lifetime membership unlocks everything.

## Blog

Articles that answer practical questions about writing and explain how to use Pure Writer. Each language has its own list page; the articles are written for readers of that language, not translated word for word.

- [Pure Writer Blog](https://writer.drakeet.com/en/blog/): list of English articles; also [简体中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hans/blog/), [繁體中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hant/blog/) and [日本語](https://writer.drakeet.com/ja/blog/)
- [How to use Pure Writer: a ten-minute tutorial](https://writer.drakeet.com/en/blog/getting-started/): a getting-started guide in the order a new user needs things, with where to find each feature on Android, iOS and desktop; also in [简体中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hans/blog/getting-started/), [繁體中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hant/blog/getting-started/), [日本語](https://writer.drakeet.com/ja/blog/getting-started/)
- [What is typewriter mode?](https://writer.drakeet.com/en/blog/typewriter-mode/): the two meanings of the term (typewriter scrolling and dimming all but the current paragraph), when to use it, and how Pure Writer's Typewriter mode works; also in [简体中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hans/blog/typewriter-mode/), [繁體中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hant/blog/typewriter-mode/), [日本語](https://writer.drakeet.com/ja/blog/typewriter-mode/)
- [Word count vs. character count](https://writer.drakeet.com/en/blog/word-count-vs-character-count/): how words and characters are counted, why tools disagree, how Chinese and Japanese text is counted, and Pure Writer's word count options; also in [简体中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hans/blog/word-count-vs-character-count/), [繁體中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hant/blog/word-count-vs-character-count/), [日本語](https://writer.drakeet.com/ja/blog/word-count-vs-character-count/)
- [How to never lose your writing](https://writer.drakeet.com/en/blog/never-lose-your-draft/): the ways drafts get lost, why sync is not a backup, how to recover lost text, and Pure Writer's six layers of protection; also in [简体中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hans/blog/never-lose-your-draft/), [繁體中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hant/blog/never-lose-your-draft/)
- [How to sync writing between your phone and computer](https://writer.drakeet.com/en/blog/sync-writing-between-phone-and-computer/): three common approaches compared, how to avoid overwrites, and how to set up cloud sync in Pure Writer; also in [简体中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hans/blog/sync-writing-between-phone-and-computer/), [繁體中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hant/blog/sync-writing-between-phone-and-computer/), [日本語](https://writer.drakeet.com/ja/blog/sync-writing-between-phone-and-computer/)
- [Is your writing private in a writing app?](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hans/blog/writing-app-privacy/) (Chinese only: [简体中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hans/blog/writing-app-privacy/), [繁體中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hant/blog/writing-app-privacy/)): where the risks to a manuscript come from, a checklist for judging any writing app, and where Pure Writer keeps documents and backups
- [Garbled text in a TXT file](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hans/blog/txt-encoding-garbled-text/) (Chinese only: [简体中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hans/blog/txt-encoding-garbled-text/), [繁體中文](https://writer.drakeet.com/zh-hant/blog/txt-encoding-garbled-text/)): why TXT files show garbled characters (UTF-8 vs. GBK or Big5), how to reopen or convert them, and the encodings Pure Writer uses for export and import
